approach: Static PowerPC-to-C++ recompilation to native Windows x64 using ReXGlue 0.10.0 and the Xenos GPU backend.
notes: Early development, single-player only. Native menus and Saint-Lo gameplay have been tested. Island loading, player control and a Saint-Lo-to-Island transition have been verified in local development builds. The full campaign is not supported yet; stability, spatial audio and seamless in-process transitions remain under development. Original user-owned Xbox 360 game assets are required.
